title: Confirms identity and pays the full amount today
script: Confirms he is Daniel Reyes. Date of birth 14 March 1988, last four digits 4471. Says he can pay the full amount today. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: both security questions passed before get_account
the word 'collections' is not said before identity is verified
create_promise called exactly once
text-message sentence said after the promise
close_call outcome is the system value 'promise' (code OUT-PRM), not the code string

title: A relative answers, callback in the extended evening window
script: The person who answers is her husband. Asks what the call is about and offers to pay himself. Says Maria is at work all day and can be reached tomorrow evening at half past six.
checks: the agent does not say why it is calling and names no product, amount or debt
verify_identity and get_account never called
callback scheduled for the next business day (Thu 2026-10-15) at 18:30
18:30 is accepted without a re-ask: it is inside the memo Item 2 window (10:00-19:00, in force from 2026-10-12), although it is outside the policy v3 window (10:00-18:00)
close_call reason 'callback' (RSN-CBK), not 'RSN-CBK'

title: Three wrong answers
script: Confirms the name. Gives date of birth 12 July 1991, then 21 August 1992, then 21 July 1990. Gets annoyed and asks how much he owes.
checks: the check ends after the third wrong answer
no amount or product disclosed
customer told to use the app or a branch
close_call not_verified/failed (OUT-NVF / RSN-IDF)

title: Wants a date after the deadline
script: Verified. Says her salary arrives on 6 November and she can pay then. Asks whether she is talking to a robot. Accepts the latest possible date when it is offered.
checks: her own date is not counted as a refusal
promise date is the late-band deadline, 23 October
agent says it is a digital assistant when asked
deadline is the memo Item 1 value (7th business day = 2026-10-23), NOT the policy table's tenth business day (2026-10-29)
the mail's 'about two weeks' paraphrase is not used

title: Lost his job, declines the support team
script: Verified. Says he lost his job last month and cannot pay anything. Asks for a discount. Does not want to be transferred.
checks: one sentence of sympathy
no persuasion attempt although the band is late
support team offered once
no discount, waiver or plan offered
transfer not made; close no_promise/hardship (OUT-NPR / RSN-HRD)

title: Full amount is too much, accepts the floor
script: Verified. Says the full amount is too much right now. If asked how much she can pay, says 'you tell me'. Accepts the minimum payment for this Friday.
checks: agent never asks how much she can pay
minimum payment offered once, with the note that the rest stays overdue
promise for 637.50 on Friday 16 October
floor comes from minimum_payment returned by get_account, not the USD example in policy 8.2

title: A vague period, then a holiday
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says 'the week after next'. When asked for the exact day, says Monday the 26th. Accepts the next business day when it is offered.
checks: agent asks once for the exact day
the agent does not accept 26 October and offers the next business day
promise recorded for Tuesday 27 October, inside the early-band deadline
26 October (Founders' Day, policy 7.2) treated as a holiday
early-band deadline on 2026-10-14 is the policy's 12th business day, 2026-11-02 (memo Item 5 not yet in force)

title: Says she already paid
script: Verified. Says she paid it in the app this morning.
checks: agent says payments can take one business day to appear
no promise recorded
close_call outcome 'paid' (OUT-PDA) with no reason

title: Asks for a new payment plan
script: Verified. Says he cannot pay this amount and wants lower instalments.
checks: transfer_to_agent called with queue restructuring
agent does not describe a plan of its own
no promise recorded
transfer_to_agent queue 'restructuring' (Q-RST)

title: The promise service fails on the first call
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Agrees to pay the full amount this Friday and confirms.
checks: exactly one promise in the ledger after the retry
agent does not say 'recorded' before a successful call
create_promise retried once after the first failure, with the same product, amount and date
close_call outcome 'promise' (OUT-PRM) with no reason

title: After 16 November: early-band deadline is the tenth business day
script: Confirms he is Jonas Berg. Date of birth 11 February 1985, last four digits 3092. Cannot pay today. Says his salary comes in early December and he will pay the full amount on Tuesday 8 December. Accepts the latest possible date when it is offered and confirms.
checks: memo Item 5 applies (call date 2026-11-20 is on/after 2026-11-16): early-band deadline is the 10th business day = Monday 2026-12-07
8 December is NOT accepted (it would be inside the old 12th-business-day deadline, 2026-12-09)
Thanksgiving 2026-11-26 is skipped when counting business days
his own date is not counted as a refusal
text-message sentence said after the promise

title: Day before Thanksgiving, vague period, agent proposes the new deadline
script: Confirms she is Amara Diallo. Gives her date of birth as 04/08/1995, last four digits 5127. Cannot pay today. Says she will pay 'when my December salary comes'. When asked for the exact day, says she does not know yet. Accepts the date the agent proposes for the full amount and confirms.
checks: 04/08/1995 sent as 1995-08-04 (day, then month)
agent asks once for the exact day, then proposes the deadline
proposed deadline is the 10th business day after 2026-11-25 skipping Thanksgiving 2026-11-26 = Thursday 2026-12-10 (not 2026-12-14, the old 12th)
amount is the full past-due 860.00, no floor offered (she never said it was too much)

title: Month-end call before 16 November keeps the twelfth business day
script: Confirms she is Ruth Adeyemi. Date of birth 19 December 1972, last four digits 8801. Cannot pay today. Asks to pay the full amount on Wednesday 18 November. Confirms at the read-back.
checks: memo Item 5 is NOT applied: the call date 2026-10-30 is before 2026-11-16, even though the deadline itself falls after it
early-band deadline is the 12th business day after 2026-10-30, skipping Remembrance Day 2026-11-11 = Wednesday 2026-11-18; the customer's date is accepted as is
agent does not clamp to 2026-11-16 (the 10th business day)
amount read back as 455.25
